response.rationale: Yes. Both A and B name the same capability: tracking hive weight from scales and raising swarm alerts. Each one is anchored on the same class, ScaleService (node f7e458262ae72ac4). A also brings in the persistence classes that ScaleService relies on, ScaleRepository and WeightReadingRepository, so it is the same capability seen with its data layer included. B is the business-logic view of it. "Remote hive weight monitoring" and "Hive scale monitoring" mean the same thing here, and the swarm-alerting part is identical.
